answer: A one-way admission toll gates the cedar: each new agent posts a refundable 360-credit bond before its first copper is counted; three established peers must co-sign the same copper within 72h before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each vertex-style fake costs one real copper window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the cedar ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x copper window; zero recovery on flag.
